final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS baseline_avg FROM compliancecase), qualifying AS (SELECT brokrepstat, avg_modelconf FROM status_avgs CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE avg_modelconf > baseline_avg), qualifying_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS mean_qualifying_avg FROM qualifying) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_modelconf, q.avg_modelconf - b.baseline_avg AS avg_minus_baseline, q.avg_modelconf / m.mean_qualifying_avg AS avg_divided_by_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying AS q CROSS JOIN baseline AS b CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_qualifying_avg IS NOT NULL
